// J1939 PGN 61444 (0xF004) EEC1 — Electronic Engine Controller 1, priority 0, PDU2 (broadcast), source address 0x00
//
// Decode pseudo-code generated by CanViewer from j1939.dbc.
// data[0] .. data[7] are the payload bytes; bit 0 is the least significant bit of a byte.
// Shifts and masks work on unsigned integers wide enough for the signal.

// Engine_Torque_Mode: start bit 0, 4 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 15
Engine_Torque_Mode_raw = data[0] & 0x0F
Engine_Torque_Mode = Engine_Torque_Mode_raw

// Actual_Engine___Percent_Torque_H: start bit 4, 4 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 15
Actual_Engine___Percent_Torque_H_raw = data[0] >> 4
Actual_Engine___Percent_Torque_H = Actual_Engine___Percent_Torque_H_raw

// Driver_s_Demand_Engine___Percent: start bit 8, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 255
Driver_s_Demand_Engine___Percent_raw = data[1]
Driver_s_Demand_Engine___Percent = Driver_s_Demand_Engine___Percent_raw

// Actual_Engine___Percent_Torque: start bit 16, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 255
Actual_Engine___Percent_Torque_raw = data[2]
Actual_Engine___Percent_Torque = Actual_Engine___Percent_Torque_raw

// Engine_Speed: start bit 24, 16 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 65535
Engine_Speed_raw = data[3] | (data[4] << 8)
Engine_Speed = Engine_Speed_raw

// Source_Address_of_Controlling_De: start bit 40, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 255
Source_Address_of_Controlling_De_raw = data[5]
Source_Address_of_Controlling_De = Source_Address_of_Controlling_De_raw

// Engine_Starter_Mode: start bit 48, 4 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 15
Engine_Starter_Mode_raw = data[6] & 0x0F
Engine_Starter_Mode = Engine_Starter_Mode_raw

// Engine_Demand___Percent_Torque: start bit 56, 8 bits, Intel, unsigned, factor 1, offset 0, range 0 .. 255
Engine_Demand___Percent_Torque_raw = data[7]
Engine_Demand___Percent_Torque = Engine_Demand___Percent_Torque_raw
